options.content: ● fine   ● needs attention   ● data problem   ● not applicable  ·  ⓘ limits and definitions  ·  For management and Ensaras support

panels.description: Readings stored in the last 15 minutes. Fresh = data in the last 5 minutes, Late = last data 5–15 minutes ago, Stale = nothing for 15 minutes. Assumes one message per minute.

targets.query: SELECT count(*) FROM /^(plc|mqtt_consumer|mqtt)$/ WHERE time > now() - 15m

panels.title: Data feed

panels.description: Time of the most recent reading stored in InfluxDB.

targets.query: SELECT * FROM /^(plc|mqtt_consumer|mqtt)$/ WHERE time > now() - 30d ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Last reading

panels.description: Readings stored in the last 24 hours ÷ 1,440 (one per minute). Healthy ≥ 98 %, attention 90–98 %, problem below 90 %. Sites that send more than one reading a minute show 100 %+; use the hourly chart on the site view to spot their gaps.

targets.query: SELECT count(*) FROM /^(plc|mqtt_consumer|mqtt)$/ WHERE time > now() - 24h GROUP BY time(1h) fill(0)

panels.title: Completeness, last 24 h

panels.description: Every active team in this organization, found from the portal. A daily form is one entered on at least 20 of the last 30 days; missed = no entry dated yesterday (IST). "—" = the team has no daily forms.
